IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION NO. 3430 OF 2024
Pooja Kamala Yadav … Petitioner
V/s.
The State of Maharashtra & Ors. … Respondents
Ms. Gunjan Shah i/b Kayval P . Shah for Petitioner.
Mr. V .N. Sagare, A.P .P . for Respondent No.1-State.
API Mr. D.S. Jamdade, Malvani Police Station, Mumbai, present.  
CORAM   : A. S. GADKARI AND
DR. NEELA GOKHALE, JJ.
DATE       : 12th August 2024.
P.C. :
1) Learned A.P .P . on instructions from the Assistant Police Inspector
Mr. D.S. Jamdade, attached to Malvani Police Station, Mumbai, subm itted
that, as the offences alleged in present Petition against the accused are not
grave or of serious nature, no steps are adopted by the Investigating  Agency
against him till today .
2) It  is  a  paradox  to  the  general  claim  made  by  the  State
Administration that, the offences against women are promptly and se riously
investigated by the Investigating Agencies.  In view thereof, we direct the
Joint Commissioner of Police (Law & Order), Mumbai, to file a  detailed
Reply to the Petition.
1/2

RVC                                                                                                                                                          56  Wp-3430-2024.doc
3)  Learned counsel appearing for the Petitioner submitted that,
even as of today , the accused in present crime is constantly harassing the
victim.
3.1) If it is true, then we request the Joint Commissioner of Pol ice
(Law & Order), Mumbai, to adopt all appropriate remedial measures in that
behalf.
4) The said Reply/Affidavit be filed within a period of o ne week
from today .
5) Stand over to 2 nd September 2024.
     ( DR. NEELA GOKHALE, J. ) ( A.S. GADKARI, J. )
2/2
RAJESH
VASANT
CHITTEWAN
